title: Simulate Time-to-Event Data from PK/PD and Bespoke ODE Models
text: simtte addresses two related simulation needs: Joint PK/PD time--event simulation (sim_tte_ode()): hazard driven drug concentration, PD response, target-mediated disposition quantity, integrated directly part ODE system — either one six built-library models, mrgsolve model converted tte_model(). Event times generated inverse transform sampling (Bender et al., 2005), optional sub-grid refinement (event_time_method = "log_survival"). Cox-model (proportional-hazards) data: simulate via flexible M-spline baseline hazard (sim_tte_ode(model = "mspline") plus covariates; see ?sim_tte_ode, “Simulating Cox model”, worked example vignette("pkpd-time--event")).
